entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your blessings are longer lasting, and you can bless more than one item at a time.

Prerequisite(s): Bless Equipment, Improved Bless Equipment, caster level 12th, channel energy class feature.

Benefit(s): The duration of your equipment blessings doubles. In addition, as a standard action you may bless up to two pieces of equipment within range with a single blessing, expending uses of channeled energy as if you had only blessed one item.
